page: Amazon Web Services i7i.4xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8559C processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 16 virtual CPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The dedicated CPU operates at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz and includes a 320 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 6 GHz, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 3750 GB NVMe SSD, while network performance features a baseline bandwidth of 9 Gbps. There are no GPUs present on this instance.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong memory and single-core capabilities. The Geekbench single-core score of 2308.0 and the text processing score of 2840.0 both rank in the top tier (top 10%). Memory performance is notable, with a large-block memory write speed of 91.67 GB/sec and a Passmark memory score of 2799.27, both placing in the top 25%. Single-threaded gzip compression also performs in the top 25% at 34.75 GB/sec. For language processing, the instance achieves a top-tier text generation speed of 395.0 tokens/sec using a small 135M model, while larger model inference and multi-core operations generally align with middle-tier averages.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the i7i.4xlarge offers high resource density by bundling a substantial 3750 GB local NVMe SSD directly with 128.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory. This hardware profile reduces the need for external storage attachments for data-intensive operations. The instance is suited for workloads requiring rapid local storage access and strong single-core execution, such as relational databases, transactional processing, indexing, caching layers, and localized data compression tasks.
